description: This file defines an interface for AWS token objects, specifying methods for retrieving token data and expiration info.

classes.name: TokenInterface
classes.description: Interface that provides methods to access AWS token information such as token string, expiration, and conversion to array.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the token string used for AWS service access.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns the UNIX timestamp when the token expires, or null if it does not expire.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the token information into an associative array.
